lead.headline: The Champ Smells Blood
lead.deck: Undefeated Stroke The Post is a projected underdog to Send Nudes, 171.2 to 169.4. Jeff Longwood's upset of the week is Ben Football Team over brimley, and the injury report reaches nine of twelve rosters.

stories.role: Sunday Picks · Never Met a Parlay He Didn't Like
stories.headline: I'm Telling You. This Is How I Win.
intro: I spent all night with the Vegas board, and I need you to understand something. The projections tell you who's better. The board tells you who's playing in a shootout and who's stuck in a 38-point rock fight. That's where the money is. Six games. Six calls. One of them is going to make me rich.

sections.note: Chalk, but the right chalk. The Burrow-Chase stack in a 51.5-point game is the best two-man combo in this matchup.
p: Everybody's treating Stroke The Post like the house because it's 3-0. Wake up. The computer has the champ favored, so this isn't an upset. This is the favorite nobody believes in, which is my favorite kind of bet.

Here's what the board says. Send Nudes has Joe Burrow and Ja'Marr Chase together against Jacksonville, the highest total on the whole slate at 51.5. When that game goes off, the champ gets paid twice. Derrick Henry gets Tennessee with Baltimore laying 11.5, which means a fourth quarter full of clock-killing carries, and that's Henry's favorite food. Jahmyr Gibbs closes it out Sunday night in Carolina with the Lions implied for 27.

Stroke's problem is the calendar. Three of its starters play Monday night, on both sides of the same game: Michael Penix and Drake London for Atlanta, Chris Olave for New Orleans. Stroke won't know if it won until Tuesday. Garrett Wilson draws Chicago with the Jets implied for 20. James Cook against New England is the best spot on the roster, Buffalo at 28.
The risk is Mike Evans and his ribs at 3:25 against Denver. If he's inactive, swap him and keep the pick.

sections.note: Bijan wins, but if you gave me #StopAsianHate plus 12, I'd take the points.
p: Twelve points is a big number, and I'm telling you right now the board says this is closer. #StopAsianHate has six starters in offenses implied for 25 or more. Lamar Jackson and Zay Flowers get Tennessee. Kenneth Walker and Rashee Rice are in Kansas City's 26-point spot against the Raiders. Jaylen Warren already put up 15.6 Thursday.

But watch the Baltimore number. Ravens minus 11.5 means a blowout, and in blowouts Lamar spends the fourth quarter in a headset. Flowers is questionable with a hamstring on top of that. That's how 165 turns into 140.

Bijan Your Face has the soft spot too. Ashton Jeanty and Brock Bowers both play for a Raiders team implied for 21.8 as 4.5-point dogs. Trailing script is great for Bowers' targets and bad for Jeanty's carries. Josh Allen against New England at 28 implied fixes everything, and Bijan Robinson sweats it out Monday night.
Straight up, I'm on the 209-a-week machine. Against the number? Different story.

sections.note: Sheev minus 50 and I'd still lay it. Four Panic starters play in offenses implied for 18 or less.
p: I've seen bad lineups. I've never seen a lineup this deep in the dead zone. Panic Trade Project starts Jaylen Wright in Miami, implied for 14.2 points as a 10-point dog in Minnesota. Carnell Tate plays for a Titans offense implied for 15.5 against Baltimore. Emeka Egbuka catches passes from Jalon Daniels in a game with a 38.5 total, tied for the lowest on the board. Keaton Mitchell runs into Seattle as a 7-point dog.
That's four starters in offenses projected for 18 points or fewer. That's not a lineup. That's a hostage situation.

Sheev already has 33.3 points from Thursday, Brock Purdy and Deebo Samuel get Denver at home with San Francisco implied for 25, and C.J. Stroud gets Dallas indoors. The commissioner's first win of the season is the safest bet I'll make all year. I'm putting my watch on it. Don't ask which watch.

sections.note: UPSET. Five Ben starters play in offenses implied for 25 or more. brimley has one.
p: This is the one. The projection says brimley by 24. The Vegas board says the game environments are lopsided the other way, and I trust Vegas a lot more than I trust a spreadsheet.

Look where brimley's points live. Jordan Love and Christian Watson both play in Green Bay at Tampa, a 38.5 total, tied for the lowest on the board. Bucky Irving plays on the other side of that same game for a Bucs offense with Jalon Daniels at quarterback, implied for 17.8. That's three brimley starters stuck in the slowest game of the week. Stefon Diggs gets Marcus Mariota. Saquon Barkley gets the Rams with Philly implied for 21. DJ Moore in Buffalo is the only starter with a real ceiling.

Now Ben. Jared Goff and Sam LaPorta stack together in Detroit's Sunday night game, Lions implied for 27 in a 50.5 total, and Chuba Hubbard plays on the other side of it. Patrick Mahomes gets the Raiders with Kansas City at 26.2. Rashid Shaheed and Devaughn Vele both play in 25-point spots. Denzel Boston already banked 12.9 Thursday.
Everybody laughed when Ben traded for a 31-year-old quarterback. Today the 31-year-old quarterback pays for my dinner.

sections.note: Jackie, but only if somebody wakes up for the London inactives. That game kicks at 8:30 a.m. Central.
p: I wanted to fade Jackie aCHANe. I really did. Two questionable receivers, the worst lineup decisions in the league, Nico Collins rotting on the bench. Then I looked at the board and it wouldn't let me.

God Bless Vodka is in trouble at quarterback and running back. Justin Herbert and Omarion Hampton play for a Chargers team implied for 18 as 7-point dogs in Seattle. Geno Smith gets Chicago with the Jets at 20. Matthew Golden is in the 38.5-point Green Bay game. Jameson Williams on Sunday night in Carolina is Vodka's best bet, and one receiver doesn't win a week.

Jackie, meanwhile, has Chase Brown in Cincinnati's 27-point spot, Khalil Shakir with Buffalo at 28, and Kyler Murray against a Dolphins team getting 10 points. Even the Houston backfield split between David Montgomery and Woody Marks lands in a 25-point environment.

The catch: Terry McLaurin and Keenan Allen are both questionable, and both play in the London game, which kicks at 8:30 in the morning our time. Inactives come out around 7. If Jackie sleeps in, Jackie loses.

sections.note: Naughty Boys lead 11.4 to 3.1 already and project by 21. I always take the points.
p: Two 0-3 teams, and both of them want to lose this game. Here's the beautiful part: Very Naughty Boys owns its own first-round pick AND Sheev's. So poulbri is rooting against his own team today and against the commissioner too. Nobody in this league has more reasons to cheer for chaos.

There's a sneaky angle for ClutchJuice: Drake Maye in Buffalo as a 7-point dog. Trailing teams throw all afternoon, and garbage-time quarterback points count the same as real ones. Rashod Bateman in Baltimore's 27-point spot helps too.

But Very Naughty Boys has the better board. Dalton Kincaid gets New England with Buffalo implied for 28. Jordan Addison gets every target Justin Jefferson isn't there to take. Sam Darnold plays at home as a 7-point favorite. They're up 11.4 to 3.1 from Thursday. I'll take the points.

stories.headline: Chicago Loses Its Quarterback, and Four of You Feel It
paragraphs: Good morning. Final injury reports are in, and the most important name on them isn't in anyone's starting lineup. Caleb Williams is out with a hamstring injury, and Case Keenum starts for Chicago. That downgrade runs through four of our rosters: Sheev's Luther Burden and Kyle Monangai, Stroke The Post's D'Andre Swift, Very Naughty Boys' Colston Loveland, and Panic Trade Project's Rome Odunze.

The questionable list matters most in the game of the week. Mike Evans is questionable for Send Nudes with a rib injury. He has said he intends to play, and rib injuries rarely cost a receiver snaps once he's active. Zay Flowers is questionable for #StopAsianHate with a hamstring. Reporting out of Baltimore is optimistic, but hamstrings are the injury most likely to reappear mid-game.

Jackie aCHANe carries the most risk this morning. Terry McLaurin was a late addition to Washington's report with a hamstring, Keenan Allen is questionable with a groin issue, and Jayden Daniels is out, so Marcus Mariota is throwing to both. Jackie needs a plan B for each before kickoff.

Panic Trade Project has a timing problem. Jalen Coker is questionable with a quad injury, and Carolina plays Sunday night. If Coker starts and is ruled inactive Sunday evening, there may be nobody left on the bench who hasn't already played. A safer starter now beats an empty slot later.
Inactive lists come out about 90 minutes before each kickoff. Check them. These designations tell you who's at risk, not who sits.

injuries.impact: Case Keenum starts. Downgrade for Luther Burden and Kyle Monangai (Sheev), D'Andre Swift (Stroke The Post), Colston Loveland (Very Naughty Boys) and Rome Odunze (Panic Trade Project).
Sleeper projects Jalon Daniels to start, owned by Send Nudes. Downgrade for Emeka Egbuka (Panic), Chris Godwin (Very Naughty Boys), Cade Otton (ClutchJuice) and Bucky Irving (brimley).
More targets for Jordan Addison (Very Naughty Boys). Aaron Jones (Send Nudes) should see more work. Kyler Murray (Jackie aCHANe) loses his top target.
Marcus Mariota starts. Downgrade for Terry McLaurin (Jackie aCHANe), Jacory Croskey-Merritt (Very Naughty Boys) and Stefon Diggs (brimley).
Says he will play. A starter for Send Nudes in the game of the week.
Optimism he plays. #StopAsianHate's second-best projected receiver.
Late addition is a bad sign. Jackie aCHANe should line up a replacement.
Low projection (8.9) even if active. Jackie's second questionable starter.
Plays Sunday night. If inactive, Panic Trade Project may have no healthy swap left.

lead.headline: Ben Football Team Burns It Down
lead.deck: Three trades in one week. Patrick Mahomes is in, Drake Maye is out, and a future first is gone. Meanwhile the waiver wire went quiet.

stories.headline: The Waiver Wire Went Quiet. Panic Trade Project Didn't.
paragraphs: This was a trade week, and the waiver wire showed it. Only two Week 4 claims cost anything: Send Nudes paid $8 for receiver Konata Mumpfield and cut Joe Flacco to make room, and Bijan Your Face spent $1 on Kalif Raymond. Everyone else shopped the $0 bin.

The best value of the week might be the cheapest. Jackie aCHANe picked up Samaje Perine for nothing. He won't win anyone a week, but Jackie has started the league's least efficient lineups, and a usable depth back costs exactly zero.

The real spending happened a week earlier, and it was all Panic Trade Project. bhegg97 dropped $32 of FAAB in one night, $16 on Keaton Mitchell and $16 more on Jaylen Wright, the running back ClutchJuice had just cut. Then he traded for Emeka Egbuka. Two trades, two big claims, one week. The team name is not a joke.

Send Nudes also made a quiet move worth watching: $14 for Jalon Daniels in Week 3. In a superflex league, any quarterback projected to start is never a throwaway claim. The defending champ is stocking the cupboard.

stories.headline: Six Games, Six Questions
paragraphs: No picks here. Jeff Longwood handles those on Sunday, after the injury report settles. This is the scouting file: what each matchup hinges on, by the numbers.

The game of the week is a coin flip on paper. Send Nudes projects at 171.2 and Stroke The Post at 169.4, and both scored exactly 193.7 last week. The difference is construction. Send Nudes starts Gibbs, Henry, Kyren Williams and Aaron Jones, the best projected backfield in the league. Stroke counters with Lamb, Olave, London and Garrett Wilson.

The schedule has been loud. Sheev and brimley have each faced more than 179 points a game, the two toughest slates in the league. Jackie aCHANe and Panic Trade Project have faced fewer than 92. Records built on those numbers tend to regress, in both directions.

One number to watch all season: lineup efficiency. ClutchJuice sets the best lineups in the league at 94% and is 0-3 anyway. Jackie aCHANe sets the worst at 74% and is 2-1. Talent and decisions are separate problems, and right now they're producing opposite results.

intel.note: Mirror images. Both teams scored 193.7 last week. Send Nudes owns the backfield by 17.9 projected points; Stroke owns the receivers by 20.0. Whichever unit hits decides it.
Bijan's 209 average is inflated by a 257-point Week 2, but its floor is still 183. #StopAsianHate has the better projected receiver group, 68.3 to 64.0, and trails by only 9.1 overall.
The biggest quarterback gap of the week: 20.1 projected points. Sheev has faced 179 points a game, the second-toughest schedule. Panic has faced 91, the second-easiest.
brimley's 89% lineup efficiency and 201.5 points allowed per game say the record is the schedule's fault. Ben's roster is new; its 101 average describes a team that no longer exists.
Jackie wins on the ground by 14.6; Vodka answers at tight end by 10.2. Jackie's 74% lineup efficiency is the worst in the league. Start-sit decisions are the swing factor.
Two winless teams. Four rookie starters without projections between them make this the least predictable game of the week.

breakdown.headline: The Unluckiest 0‑3 You'll Ever See
breakdown.verdict: Dynasty power hiding behind a bad record. Youngest roster among the top six.
breakdown.move: Hold. Do not sell low because of the record. If anything, consolidate two of the four quarterbacks into one elite piece.
p: Sheev is 0-3. Sheev is also the fourth-most valuable team in this league. Both things are true.

The record is mostly bad luck. Sheev has scored 150 a week, fifth in the league, and faced 179.3 points a game, the second-toughest schedule. The all-play mark is 1.91, which means an average schedule produces about a 2-1 start. The luck factor is -1.91, the worst in the league by more than a full win.

The roster is the youngest of the top six. Value-weighted age is 24.8, and 60% of the team's value sits in players 25 or younger. Only Deebo Samuel (30.7) and Marcus Mariota (32.9) are 29 or older, and together they're 5% of the value. Tetairoa McMillan, Luther Burden, Jordyn Tyson, Quinshon Judkins, Harold Fannin and TreVeyon Henderson are all 24 or younger.
The quarterback room is crowded: Brock Purdy, Jayden Daniels (out this week), C.J. Stroud and Mariota. In superflex that's leverage. Four quarterbacks for two slots is a trade waiting to happen.

One real concern: Sheev doesn't own its 2027 first or second. Very Naughty Boys has the first, Panic Trade Project the second, and at 0-3 that first currently projects early. Sheev does hold Ben Football Team's 2027 first, #StopAsianHate's 2028 first and an extra 2028 second, which softens the blow. The model projects 6.0 wins.

breakdown.headline: The League's Best Young Backfield, and a Pick Swap That Cost It
breakdown.verdict: Rebuild with real youth. Jeremiyah Love is a cornerstone. Trading its own early first hurts.
breakdown.move: Sell George Kittle now. He's 33, he still scores, and contenders will pay for that.
p: God Bless Vodka has one of the healthiest rosters in the league from an age standpoint. Value-weighted age is 25.5, and 58% of the team's value is in players 25 or younger.

The centerpiece is Jeremiyah Love. At 21.3, he's the 12th most valuable asset in dynasty and the youngest player in the top 15. Omarion Hampton (23.5) and Jadarian Price (23.0) give Vodka three young backs, though Price is in the IR slot. Matthew Golden (23.1) and Cam Ward (24.3) add youth at receiver and quarterback.

The outlier is George Kittle. At 33.0, he's the oldest starter on the roster and an injury risk every week; tight ends that age wear down fast. He's still productive, which makes him a sell candidate rather than a hold.
The current team is middling: 1-2 with an all-play of 1.27, so the record is close to fair. The model projects 5.5 wins.

Here's the catch. Bijan Your Face owns Vodka's 2027 first and second, and that first currently projects early. Vodka holds Bijan's 2027 first in return, but that one projects late. Vodka also has two 2027 thirds and its own 2028 first, second and third. For a rebuilding team, swapping an early first for a late one is an expensive trade.

breakdown.headline: The Champ Is Reloading, Not Rebuilding
breakdown.verdict: Dynasty power. Three elite young skill players, the oldest value profile in the league, and no 2027 first.
breakdown.move: Get a 2027 first back. Derrick Henry is the obvious sale before he turns 33.
p: The defending champion didn't run it back with the same roster. RandleSavage has been quietly reshaping it, and the result is the second-most valuable team in the league at 70,159.

The foundation is three players most of this league would trade its whole roster for: Jahmyr Gibbs (24.5), Ja'Marr Chase (26.6) and Puka Nacua (25.3), the second, fifth and sixth most valuable assets in dynasty. Tyler Warren, at 24.3, gives them a long-term answer at tight end.

Here's what I'm hearing about the quarterbacks. Baker Mayfield is in the IR slot and out with a thumb injury. Send Nudes spent $14 of FAAB on Jalon Daniels in Week 3, and Sleeper projects Daniels to start for Tampa Bay this week. That looks like a manager covering his own injury before it became a crisis.

The age problem is real, though. Derrick Henry is 32.7, Joe Burrow 29.8, and A.J. Brown, in the IR slot, 29.2. Thirty-four percent of this roster's value sits in players 29 or older, the highest share in the league.

And the premium picks are gone. Very Naughty Boys holds Send Nudes' 2027 first and second. What's left is its own 2027 third and its 2028 first, second and third. The record is fair, 2-1 against an all-play of 2.36, with a 9.7-win projection. This window is open, but it's on a clock.

breakdown.headline: Full Teardown, Full Pick Board
breakdown.verdict: Rebuild, and the most committed one in the league. More draft capital than anyone.
breakdown.move: Keep doing exactly this. Flip any veteran that scores points in October for more 2028 picks.
p: ClutchJuice is 0-3 and ranks 11th in dynasty value. That's not a problem. That's the plan.

ClutchJuice holds 25,612 points of draft capital, the most in the league. Three 2027 firsts: its own, brimley's and #StopAsianHate's. Three 2027 seconds: its own, Panic Trade Project's and Jackie aCHANe's. Three 2027 thirds. Two 2028 firsts, its own and Sheev's. Only Very Naughty Boys is close.

The roster is the other half of the plan, and it's thin by design. Drake Maye, acquired for Patrick Mahomes, is the only player valued above 1,500 in dynasty. The rest is young depth: Braelon Allen, Caleb Douglas, Pat Bryant, Malachi Fields, Germie Bernard and a taxi squad of recent draft picks. Value-weighted age is 24.2, and 86% of the value sits in players 25 or younger, the highest share in the league.

Credit where it's due: ClutchJuice sets the most efficient lineups in the league, capturing 94% of its available points. The manager isn't tanking with bad decisions. There just isn't much talent to start yet.

The model projects 2.5 wins, the fewest in the league. That makes ClutchJuice's own 2027 first a likely top-two pick. brimley's first is the wild card: it projects mid-round, but if brimley's schedule keeps beating it up, that pick climbs too.

breakdown.headline: Good Team, Wrong Schedule
breakdown.verdict: Dynasty power on paper, win-now in practice. Talented and unlucky, with the 2027 first already gone.
breakdown.move: Stay the course and buy cheap veterans. The 201.5 points allowed per game will not continue.
p: brimley has given up 604.5 points in three games. That's 201.5 a week, the most in the league by 22 points. A good team can't defend that, because nobody can.

The underlying team is solid. brimley scores 146.9 a week, sixth in the league, and sets an 89% efficient lineup. The all-play mark is 1.82, so on a normal schedule brimley is roughly 2-1, not 1-2. The luck factor is -0.82.

The roster leans on the 26-to-29 window. Trey McBride is the 10th most valuable asset in dynasty and the best tight end in the league after Brock Bowers. Trevor Lawrence and Jordan Love are a stable superflex pair. Malik Nabers, at 23.2, is the one true young star. Saquon Barkley (29.6) and DJ Moore (29.4) are on the back nine; 19% of the roster's value sits in players 29 or older.

Justin Jefferson is the wild card. He's in the IR slot and out this week with an ankle injury, and he's still the second-most valuable player on the roster. When he returns, this is one of the deepest receiver rooms in the league.

The future capital is thin at the top. ClutchJuice owns brimley's 2027 first. brimley has its own 2027 second, two 2027 thirds (its own and Stroke The Post's) and its own 2028 first and second. The model projects 7.4 wins, fifth-best in the league, which is inside the playoff line but not by much.

breakdown.headline: The Name Is Panic. The Plan Is Patience.
breakdown.verdict: Rebuild, and a well-stocked one. Youngest roster in the league and the third-most draft capital. The 2-1 record is borrowed.
breakdown.move: Don't be fooled by 2-1. Sell anything older than 26 for 2027 picks and keep stacking.
p: Panic Trade Project is 2-1. Panic Trade Project is not a 2-1 team. The all-play mark is 0.73, meaning a typical schedule produces fewer than one win. The luck factor is +1.27, the most in the league, helped by just 91 points allowed per game, the second-easiest schedule.
But I don't think bhegg97 cares about this season, and he shouldn't. This is the youngest roster in the league by value-weighted age, 23.9, with 84% of its value in players 25 or younger.

The quarterback plan is a three-way bet: Bo Nix (26.6), Jaxson Dart (23.4), the most valuable player on the roster, and rookie Ty Simpson on the taxi squad. The receiver room is all youth: Emeka Egbuka, Carnell Tate (21.7), Makai Lemon, Jalen Coker, Marvin Harrison Jr. and Rome Odunze. Running back is the hole. Keaton Mitchell and Jaylen Wright are FAAB adds, and Kaleb Johnson came over in the ClutchJuice trade.

The draft capital is 15,321, third-most in the league: its own 2027 first, Stroke The Post's 2027 first, 2027 seconds from Sheev and Ben Football Team, its own 2028 first, and 2028 seconds from Stroke and itself.

Its own 2027 first slots mid-round right now because of the 2-1 record. The model projects only 5.0 wins, the third-fewest in the league, so that pick should climb. The trades have a plan, even if the team name doesn't.

breakdown.headline: A Young Star and Two Quarterbacks on the Clock
breakdown.verdict: Dynasty power, but thin on picks after the Judkins and Walker trades.
breakdown.move: Protect the quarterback depth. Lamar Jackson's back and Jalen Hurts' age are the two risks that matter most.
p: #StopAsianHate ranks third in dynasty value at 67,531 and has the youngest value-weighted age of the top three teams at 26.5. From a durability standpoint, this roster is in good shape. With two caveats.

The franchise piece is Jaxon Smith-Njigba. At 24.6, he's the fourth-most valuable asset in dynasty and the kind of receiver who gets better for three more seasons. Zay Flowers (26.0), George Pickens (25.6), Ladd McConkey (24.9) and Rashee Rice (26.4) give him the deepest supporting cast of receivers in the league.

Now the caveats. Lamar Jackson is 29.7 and listed with a back issue this week, no game designation. Jalen Hurts is 28.1. Running quarterbacks age faster than pocket passers because they take hits. In superflex, losing either one would hurt more than losing any receiver.

Kenneth Walker, acquired in the Judkins trade, is 25.9 and has missed time in past seasons. He's the lead back now, with Cam Skattebo (24.6) behind him. Rookie tight end Kenyon Sadiq is on the taxi squad and questionable this week with a back injury.

The cost of building this roster was future picks. #StopAsianHate's 2027 first and third belong to ClutchJuice, and its 2028 first and second went to Sheev. Its own 2027 second is the only pick it holds in the first two rounds of either draft. The record is fair: 2-1 against an all-play of 2.09. The model projects 9.2 wins.

breakdown.headline: The Rare Team That Wins Now and Later
breakdown.verdict: Dynasty power. Best roster today and the most draft capital of any contender.
breakdown.move: Sell Davante Adams, Dak Prescott and Tyreek Hill while they still return value. None of them will matter in 2028.
p: Bijan Your Face isn't just the best team in the league. It's the best-built one. Its dynasty score of 92,605 is more than 22,000 points clear of second-place Send Nudes.

Start with the core. Bijan Robinson (24.6), Brock Bowers (23.8) and Ashton Jeanty (22.8) are the third, seventh and 13th most valuable assets in all of dynasty, and none is older than 25. Josh Allen is No. 1 overall in superflex. Amon-Ra St. Brown is No. 8 and in his prime. Most teams in this league have one or two foundation pieces. This one has five.

The risk is the back half of the roster. A third of the team's value sits in players 29 or older: Allen and Christian McCaffrey (both 30.3), Dak Prescott (33.2), Davante Adams (33.8) and Tyreek Hill (32.6). Allen ages well because quarterbacks do. The rest are the kind of assets that lose half their value in a single offseason.

The record is earned. A 3-0 start with an all-play mark of 2.73 means Bijan would have beaten 91% of the league in an average week. Luck is a rounding error at +0.27. The model projects 11.8 wins, the best in the league.

And the cupboard is real. Bijan traded its own 2027 first to God Bless Vodka but holds Vodka's 2027 first and second in return, and Vodka's first currently projects early. Add two 2028 firsts (its own and Ben Football Team's) and Ben's 2028 third. That's 12,847 in draft capital, the most of any team in the top six.

breakdown.headline: Losing Is the Plan, and the Picks Prove It
breakdown.verdict: Rebuild with the most valuable set of 2027 firsts in the league.
breakdown.move: Keep the youth, keep the picks, and shop Send Nudes' late first for a young back if the price is right.
p: Very Naughty Boys is 0-3 and the model projects just 3.0 wins. For most teams, that's a crisis. For this one, it's a strategy, because Very Naughty Boys owns its own 2027 first, and it currently projects early.

It also owns Sheev's 2027 first, which projects early too after the commissioner's 0-3 start, plus Send Nudes' first. Three 2027 firsts, two of them early, is the most valuable set of 2027 firsts in the league. Add three 2027 seconds (its own, Send Nudes' and Bijan Your Face's) and its own 2028 first. That's 21,023 in draft capital, second only to ClutchJuice.

The young core is promising. Fernando Mendoza (23.0) is on the taxi squad as the quarterback of the future. Colston Loveland (22.5) is a long-term tight end, and rookie KC Concepcion (22.0) is already starting. Value-weighted age is 24.7.

The veterans are where the injury risk lives. Chris Godwin plays for Tampa Bay, which lost Baker Mayfield this week. J.K. Dobbins is listed with a hip issue and no game designation, and running backs with his injury history are year-to-year propositions. Sam Darnold (29.3) is the starting quarterback: a bridge, not a plan.
The luck factor is -0.36, so the record is roughly deserved. That's fine. Every loss this season makes next spring's draft more interesting.

breakdown.headline: Built for Right Now, and Right Now Only
breakdown.verdict: Dynasty power with a short window. Prime-age core, almost nothing in the draft cupboard.
breakdown.move: Use Caleb Williams as the trade chip. He's the roster's most valuable asset and its only young one, and he's the cleanest way to get a 2027 first back.
p: Stroke The Post is the purest win-now roster in the league, and I mean that as a compliment and a warning.

Look at the ages. CeeDee Lamb 27.5, Jonathan Taylor 27.7, Chris Olave 26.2, Drake London 25.2, James Cook 27.0, Garrett Wilson 26.2. Every major skill player is between 25 and 28, exactly where fantasy production peaks. Only 14% of the roster's value is in players 25 and under, the lowest share in the league.

The quarterback room is the oddity. Matthew Stafford is 38.6 and starting at superflex. Caleb Williams, at 24.8 the 11th most valuable asset in dynasty and the most valuable player on this roster, sits on the bench and is out this week with a hamstring injury.
The 3-0 record is real. The all-play mark is 2.73, tied with Bijan for best in the league, and Stroke has topped 178 points every week. The model projects 11.3 wins.

The cost shows up on the draft board. Stroke's 2027 first belongs to Panic Trade Project, its 2027 second to Ben Football Team, its 2027 third to brimley and its 2028 second to Panic. All that's left is its own 2028 first and third, worth 3,065 combined, second-fewest in the league. This roster has roughly a two-season window before the running backs age out, and very little to restock it with.

breakdown.headline: All In on a Hand the Numbers Don't Like
breakdown.verdict: Rebuild by the numbers, managed like a contender. Last in dynasty value with the fewest picks.
breakdown.move: Commit. If Ben is buying, buy one more young running back. Going halfway is the worst outcome.
p: Ben Football Team made three trades in Week 4 and walked out with Patrick Mahomes and Sam LaPorta. Ben is clearly playing to win now. The numbers say he's playing from last place.

Ben Football Team ranks 12th in dynasty value at 40,857. Thirty-one percent of the roster's value sits in players 29 or older, the third-highest share in the league. Mahomes is 31.0. Jared Goff, the other starting quarterback, is 31.9.

The draft cost of the buying spree is steep. Sheev owns Ben's 2027 first. Panic Trade Project owns Ben's 2027 second, and ClutchJuice its third. Bijan Your Face owns Ben's 2028 first and third. Ben has 2,870 in draft capital left, the least in the league: Stroke The Post's 2027 second and his own 2028 second.

The 2-1 record isn't what it looks like either. The all-play mark is 0.82, and the luck factor is +1.18, tied for second-luckiest. The new roster projects better than the old one, but the model still sees 6.1 wins.

There are young pieces here: Bhayshul Tuten (23.6), rookie Denzel Boston (22.8) and LaPorta (25.7). But this is a two-quarterback, 31-year-old core with no first-round picks for two years. If it doesn't make the playoffs this season, the recovery takes a long time.

breakdown.headline: A 2-1 Record Built on an Easy Schedule
breakdown.verdict: Rebuild. The record overstates the roster, and the roster skews older than its standing.
breakdown.move: Decide which direction this roster is going and commit to it. The current mix of veterans and middling youth gets you neither.
p: Jackie aCHANe is 2-1, and I'd describe that record as fragile. The all-play mark is 0.82. Jackie has faced just 77.5 points a game, the easiest schedule in the league by 13.5 points. The luck factor is +1.18, tied for second-luckiest.

The bigger issue is lineup management. Jackie captures 74% of its available points, the worst in the league by ten points. Nico Collins, the most valuable player on the roster, started the week on the bench and was only moved into the lineup before kickoff.

From an injury standpoint, this week is rough. De'Von Achane is in the IR slot. Terry McLaurin was ruled out with a hamstring injury, and Keenan Allen was ruled out and then released. Jackie also has three quarterbacks aged 29 or older: Kyler Murray, Daniel Jones and Aaron Rodgers.

The dynasty core is modest: Collins (27.5), Chase Brown (26.5), Achane (24.9), Bryce Young (25.2) and Tucker Kraft (25.9). Only 18% of the roster's value is in players 25 or younger, second-lowest in the league, and the team ranks 10th in value.

Jackie does own its own 2027 first, which projects mid-round, plus Panic Trade Project's 2027 third and its own 2028 first and second. Its 2027 second belongs to ClutchJuice. The model projects 6.4 wins. That's a fringe playoff team that needs to pick a direction.

dynasty.method: Dynasty score = market value of every rostered player plus draft picks. Player values come from FantasyCalc's superflex, 12-team PPR dynasty market, which covers about 400 players and already prices in age; deeper depth players get a small estimate by years in the league. Pick values also come from FantasyCalc, with 2027 firsts valued early, mid or late by the original owner's current standing. Rosters and pick ownership come straight from Sleeper. Updated with each Sunday Edition.

tradeGrades.headline: Ben Football Team Made Three Trades in One Week. I Have Notes.
tradeGrades.intro: I grade every trade three ways: value, fit and timing. Value is market price, using FantasyCalc's dynasty values for players and the same pick values as our Dynasty Rankings. Fit is whether the pieces solve a real roster problem. Timing is whether the move matches where the team actually is, not where the manager hopes it is. Winning on value with the wrong timeline is still a bad trade.

sides.reason: Sheev turned an older back into a younger one and got a first and a second for the trouble. Judkins is three years younger than Walker and already paid off with 21.6 points Thursday. For the league's youngest contender, this is exactly the right direction.

Walker is the better player today, and #StopAsianHate is a real contender, so the upgrade is defensible. But it paid a first and a second to move up roughly 3,200 in player value, and running backs lose value fast after 26. With this deal, #StopAsianHate's own 2027 second is the only pick it holds in the first two rounds of 2027 or 2028.

LaPorta is a prime-age starting tight end and fills a real hole. But Ben paid above market: Omar Cooper and a 2027 second are worth about 3,200 combined, LaPorta about 2,900. That's another future pick out the door from a team that, by my numbers, isn't a contender yet.

Panic sold a 25.7-year-old tight end for more than he's worth: rookie receiver Omar Cooper, currently on IR, plus a second-round pick from a team projected for about six wins, so that second could land early. It weakens this season's lineup, but Panic's window is two years out. Disciplined.

On paper Ben won, roughly 4,400 to 3,100. In practice, Ben traded a 2028 first from a roster with no first-round picks for two years and 31% of its value in players 29 or older. If Ben is bad in 2027, that pick is worth far more than its current price. Tuten is a nice young back. He isn't worth that risk.

Bijan Your Face had Bijan Robinson, Ashton Jeanty and Christian McCaffrey. Tuten was never starting. Turning a bench back into a future first from a roster built like Ben's is the kind of move that keeps a dynasty power on top for years.

Here's the uncomfortable part: on today's market, Ben won this trade by about 2,000 points. Mahomes is also about three points a week better than Maye right now. But Ben swapped a 24-year-old franchise quarterback for a 31-year-old one, and in superflex that's the most important position on the board. Maye's value goes up from here. Mahomes' goes down.

This is the best trade of the five. ClutchJuice is in a full rebuild, and it just converted a 31-year-old quarterback into a 24-year-old one who'll be in his prime when its three 2027 firsts mature. Giving up some market value to get the right age is exactly how rebuilds should work.

A straight swap of young players. Sheev had receivers to spare: McMillan, Parker Washington, Burden and Tyson. It needed a back, and Henderson starts every week, which is real. But Sheev gave up about 500 in value for the positional fit, and Egbuka is the better long-term asset.

Panic won on value with a same-age player, and Egbuka is the better dynasty piece. The knock is fit. Panic already had the deepest young receiver room in the league and almost nothing at running back, and this made both of those problems bigger.

tradeGrades.note: Values are current dynasty market values, not values at the time of the trade. Trade details come straight from Sleeper's transaction records.
